codex_only_mode.why: SKILL.md's verify-tier default resolves to clippy.config/models then THE PARENT MODEL, with no register consult — so on a codex-only stack the leg silently selects codex for a role this register does not certify, and nothing makes it loud. The attack seam by contrast consults the register and obliges a DECLARED tracker deviation for an uncertified tier. st-54 gives verify that same symmetry. Until it lands, codex-only mode would ship unverified work with nothing announcing it.
codex_only_mode.compounding_binding: The two codex sandbox modes contradict each other for a leg whose job is EXECUTING checks: read-only blocks pytest outright, workspace-write depresses suite counts. So a codex-only verify leg either cannot run its checks or cannot trust their counts, and the honesty floor is unsatisfiable by construction in both — the mode's setup text must say so.
